Diagnostics

High Angular Rate

Servo Tracking Degraded

Frequent Large Tracking Errors

Servo Offline Events

No Timing Data

Servo Delay Under-Compensated
MPC commands arrive too late for servo — increase RKT_MPC_SVO_DLY. Symptoms: roll reached 180° (should be <10°); pitch σ=15.9° in terminal (should be <4°); |α| reached 67.9° (should be <12°); servo tracking MAE=2.2° (servo lagging behind commands); servo tracking P95=8.6° (large transient lag)

Recommendations

Verify PX4 is armed and rocket_mpc module is running — fin commands are near-zero
Range error is -44.7% — tune MPC guidance gains or verify thrust curve
High in-flight AoA — consider lowering qp_solver_cond_N further or reducing N_horizon
Pitch oscillation in terminal phase — check damping gains and actuator bandwidth
Servo tracking MAE=2.22° exceeds 1.5° limit — check fin mechanical play, servo_auto_zero calibration, CAN bus speed
Servo 2 online only 78% — check CAN address and power to fin 2
Servo 4 online only 79% — check CAN address and power to fin 4
⚠ SERVO DELAY: Increase RKT_MPC_SVO_DLY to ~0.100s (estimated from tracking P95=8.6° + 40ms overhead). This gives lookahead_stage=5. For precise value: measure cmd→can lag on bench.
Enable timing capture: ensure 'adb reverse tcp:5760 tcp:5760' and PX4 publishes DEBUG_VECT 'TIMING' with fields mhe_us/mpc_us/cycle_us
